table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	itemname = service.name,
	reprintdate = getDate(),
	users.username,  
	dbo.serviceheader.serviceinvcode,
	doctor=(select name from doctors where doctors.doctcode=serviceheader.doctcode),   
	dbo.serviceheader.date,  
	dbo.serviceheader.headerno,
	dbo.serviceheader.discperc,   
	dbo.serviceheader.misccharges,   
	dbo.serviceheader.custcode,   
	dbo.serviceheader.remarks,
	dbo.serviceheader.flatdisc,
	reprintcounter = dbo.serviceheader.reprintingcounter,
	dbo.service.servicecode,   
	price = dbo.servicedetail.price, 
	serviceflatdisc=servicedetail.serviceflatdisc,
	Qty = dbo.servicedetail.qty,
	servicedetail_discperc = servicedetail.discperc, 
	customername=(SELECT Accounts.Name FROM Accounts WHERE Accounts.AccCode  = serviceheader.Custcode),
	patient.regno,
	patient=patient.name,
	dbo.serviceheader.saleinvcode,
	dbo.serviceheader.servicecatcode,
	tokenno = dbo.serviceheader.tokenno,
	gender=patient.gender,
	patientageyears=patient.ageyears,
	patientagemonts=patient.agemonths,
	patientagedays=patient.agedays,
	serviceinvtotal=dbo.fn_getserviceinvtotal(:ra_InvCode)
	
FROM 
	dbo.serviceheader LEFT OUTER JOIN Patient ON (dbo.serviceheader.patientcode = patient.patientcode),   
	dbo.servicedetail,  
	service, 
	users
	
WHERE 
	( dbo.serviceheader.serviceinvcode = :ra_InvCode ) AND
	( dbo.serviceheader.serviceinvcode = dbo.servicedetail.serviceinvcode ) AND 
	( dbo.serviceheader.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND
	( servicedetail.servicecode = service.servicecode )

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: /*Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  flatdisc +  serviceheader_misccharges   , 0)*/ serviceinvtotal
